svg.aria-label: Whistle, a meerkat with a whistle, stands on watch beside a striped gate across a path. 3 worker bees have reached the gate and wait in a row; a 4th is still flying in from the left. The gate stays down until every bee has arrived. A sign on the gate reads __syncthreads(), and a tag says all arrive, then all go.
